caveats: Richard Fischer case: this row aggregates roughly 21 civil lawsuits by women he assaulted on duty (2015-2017); civil claims began in 2017. Settlement figure is the aggregate: dlawgroup says $9.5M across 21 settled suits, Yahoo says 'nearly $10 million' across at least 21 cases; individual settlements varied, and the county also paid over $1M for his civil defense. Two sources (ktla.com 403, both cbs8.com links timing out) were inaccessible, including the one citing an earlier $4.6M running total. Fischer pleaded guilty in Sept 2019 to 7 counts (4 felony assault under color of authority, 2 misdemeanor assault, 1 misdemeanor false imprisonment), sentenced Dec 2019 to 44 months in county jail; not required to register as a sex offender.
